Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Blackout $ 139.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option TWO WEEK BUILD TIME Qty $ 139.00 Add to cart View cart The Blackout is a double muff. Not one into the other, but mixed parallel. Each has its own separate FUZZ, TONE and OUTput controls. The top fuzz circuit has the traditional muff tone control where the bottom one has more of a mid boost/scoop control. This thing is a sonic beast and capable of getting a much wider range of sounds than a traditional or modified single muff. Sounds massive on bass and killer on guitar and has a rad black on black color scheme. SPECS: Smaller 4.7" x 2.6" x 1.5" 125B sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9-12vdc center negative BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw ?mA. Power supply not included. sources.excerpt: Blackout by Idiotbox Effects | RockBoard | PedalPedia Skip to main content LOG IN EXPLORE Idiotbox Effects Blackout LOG IN TO SUGGEST IMPROVEMENTS FUZZ Description The Idiotbox Effects Blackout is an analog fuzz-distortion pedal featuring two separate Big Muff-style clipping circuits operating in parallel. Designed to offer maximum sonic thickness for both guitar and bass, each circuit includes independent controls for Fuzz, Tone, and Output Level. The top fuzz circuit utilizes a classic Muff-style tone stack, while the bottom circuit features an adjusted mid-boost/scoop sweep to preserve low-end clarity and mid presence. Housed in a blacked-out 125B enclosure, the pedal features true bypass switching and runs on standard external DC power or battery.
